name: @examples/gl-surfaces-playground
description: Example texturing the map's water, glaciers, forests, grass, scrub, fields, sand, mud, shingle, rock, paving, built-up ground and roads with the Landmarks 3D plugin's GLSurfaces, growing 3D trees and colouring it all for a season, with the surface, season, tree, sky and wind knobs on a panel built off glSurfacesKnobCatalogue, beside the map's light shared with the Landmarks 3D plugin's buildings and the map-effects plugin's effects over it all.
